text: Flutter Entertainment completed the acquisition of Snaitech S.p.A. (Snai) from a subsidiary of Playtech plc for a cash consideration based on an enterprise value of €2.3b (announced 30 April 2025).
short: Flutter Entertainment completed its acquisition of Snaitech (Snai) in April 2025.

source.name: GlobeNewswire - Flutter Entertainment announces completion of Snai acquisition
source.quote: today announces that it has completed the acquisition of Snaitech S.p.A. (“Snai”), one of Italy’s leading omni-channel operators from a subsidiary of Playtech plc, for cash consideration based on an enterprise value of €2.3b
